clinician.trajectory_summary: A 72-year-old Caucasian female with chronic kidney disease, GERD, remote peptic ulcer disease, and 60+ pack-year smoking history presented in May 2018 with mild intermittent left upper quadrant discomfort initially attributed to peptic ulcer disease. Initial laboratory evaluation revealed significant leukocytosis (WBC 25,600/uL with ANC 21,000/uL) and elevated alkaline phosphatase (324 U/L), with negative myeloproliferative workup (JAK2, BCR/ABL negative, normal peripheral smear). Over the following months, leukocytosis worsened (WBC 48,200/uL, ANC 42,400/uL) with development of severe anemia (6.6 g/dL). CT imaging in early September 2018 demonstrated wall thickening at the gastroesophageal junction with nodular abnormality projecting into the proximal stomach and multiple hypodensities of the liver consistent with metastatic disease. Esophagogastroduodenoscopy during hospital admission in early September 2018 revealed a fungating mass at the GEJ without active bleeding. Biopsy of this mass confirmed adenocarcinoma with HER2 overexpression (IHC score 3+). Systemic chemotherapy with FOLFOX was initiated approximately 1.5 weeks after hospital discharge based on NCCN guidelines for advanced gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma. Repeat CT imaging at 6 months post-treatment initiation demonstrated improving gastric cardia mucosal thickening and decreased hepatic metastasis, indicating treatment response.

Repeat CT imaging at 6 months post-treatment initiation demonstrated improving gastric cardia mucosal thickening and decreased hepatic metastasis, indicating treatment response.

key_supporting_evidence.claim: Initial presentation with left upper quadrant discomfort in May 2018

Negative myeloproliferative workup (JAK2 V617F, BCR/ABL negative, normal peripheral smear)
Worsening leukocytosis (WBC 48,200/uL, ANC 42,400/uL) and severe anemia (6.6 g/dL) over following months
CT chest/abdomen/pelvis in early September 2018 showed wall thickening at GEJ with nodular abnormality projecting into proximal stomach and multiple liver hypodensities
EGD revealed fungating mass at the GEJ without active bleeding during September 2018 admission
Adenocarcinoma with HER2 overexpression (IHC score 3+) confirmed by histopathology
